email.body1:
Tammy, saw RouteMate shipped its 2.0 app and worked the trucking show circuit hard this spring.

A new release plus a run of shows usually surfaces more fleets in play than the team can work before interest fades, and that gap is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for RouteMate off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tammy, quick follow-up for RouteMate.

After a launch and a stack of shows, the fleet target list grows faster than headcount can. Most leaders don't actually know how many meetings each rep needs to convert that interest, so the gap surfaces late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings RouteMate needs to keep that funnel covered without hiring more reps.
email.body3:
Tammy, last bit of proof for RouteMate.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how RouteMate's reply rate likely compares to other SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Tammy, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling fleet coverage without adding reps isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A launch-plus-tradeshow stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters most here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your sales motion? I'll tailor it to RouteMate either way.
